steps.say: Turn the focused window into a group.
steps.hint: Super + G makes a tabbed group out of the focused window. Other windows can join it.
steps.why: Groups are tabs for tiled windows: several windows, one slot.

steps.say: Cycle to the next window in the group.
steps.hint: With two windows in a group, Super + Alt + Tab switches tabs. Move the other practice window in with Super + Alt + Arrow first.
steps.why: Alt + Tab inside a group works like tabs in a browser.
